interface.longDescription: Ordinary conversation with intellectual discipline. Start with an idea, question, or decision. Dialectical helps clarify inquiry purpose and scope, surface prior art and connections, compare competing explanations, test assumptions, and seek disconfirming evidence. GUIDE can recommend one useful operation for the current conversation and asks before it acts. COLLECTION GAPS prioritizes missing evidence to seek; INDICATORS defines observable developments that warrant reassessment. These operations do not automatically collect evidence or create monitoring. All operations are optional; conversation remains primary. This skills-only plugin requires no external service. Research uses available evidence tools; continuity uses the current chat or notes you supply, with optional file storage when authorized.
defaultPrompt: Which Dialectical operation would help now?
Find prior art connected to this idea.
